prompt: The implementation and tests are complete. Close out the repository documentation: promote the durable cache-key contract from docs/plans to the appropriate canonical document, reconcile the local Notion mirror, decide whether the PR-specific dev validation report should be retained, and remove temporary material. Do not change implementation code, create an ADR without a lasting decision, commit, push, or delete Git branches/worktrees. Report the remaining Git cleanup separately.
expected_behavior: The temporary plan and one-off PR validation report are removed, the canonical design and local Notion mirror describe the implemented tenant-scoped key and legacy read fallback without copying execution evidence, and implementation files remain unchanged.
failure_conditions: the completed plan remains under docs/plans
the canonical design still documents the obsolete unscoped key
the local Notion mirror remains inconsistent with the implementation
the PR-specific validation report or its execution values are copied into local Notion
implementation code or tests are changed
